sn14.14:1.2: Here “element” means something like a “personality trait”.
sn14.14:1.3: _Adhimuttika_ appears to be a Buddhist coinage. The key text is [dm1](), where the Buddha’s ability to discern the different “convictions” of beings is illustrated with the examples of Suppiya who criticized the Buddha, Dhamma, and Saṅgha, while his student Brahmadatta praised them. This speaks to a difference in faith, which is closely associated with _adhimutta_ (eg. [an1.208:1.1]()).
